answer: Reusing one run across aliases collides on the trellis identifier and voids the later submissions, and therefore the operator pays for 235 runs and collects one. Because the reef index holds every id for the epoch, the collision is provable from the ledger, and the sonnet audit republishes the full set. Each answer commits to a run identifier that must be unique within the epoch, so 235 answers need 235 separate inference runs with separate seeds. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
